name: engine-matrix
scope: S0-ENGINE-a: engine identity, feature detection, executed feature semantics and each admitted profile suspension path, on hand-built wasm32 modules. No CCL object layout, generated B code, GC or production runtime is claimed.

node.role: reference host for every Stage 0 fixture

features.multivalue: function and block results in declared order
features.tailcall: return_call and return_call_indirect at depth 10,000,000 without stack growth
features.exceptions: final encoding: try_table with catch, catch_ref, catch_all and catch_all_ref; throw; throw_ref of a caught exnref
features.exnref: exception references survive a frame and rethrow the same exception
features.bulk: passive data segment, memory.init, memory.copy, memory.fill, data.drop, trapping reinit after drop
features.atomics: i32 atomic rmw.add, rmw.cmpxchg, load, store; memory.atomic.wait32 and memory.atomic.notify

informational_probes.legacy-eh: validation result of the prohibited legacy try/catch encoding; recorded, never emitted
informational_probes.memory64: validation result of memory64; not a project requirement

exception_encoding.pin: every emitted binary is disassembled; legacy mnemonics refuse the binary regardless of engine acceptance

jspi_api.shape: WebAssembly.Suspending wraps the host import; WebAssembly.promising wraps the Wasm export; a suspending import reached outside a promising export throws
jspi_api.absent: the single-thread JSPI profile is not admitted on that engine; the full and precompiled-callback profiles stand on their own

requires: shared wasm32 memory with explicit maximum
records: growth keeps the old SharedArrayBuffer at its old length
two suspensions through nested frames with a live local
one suspension under a tail-called frame
atomic rmw/cmpxchg/load/store succeed on unshared memory
